name: brand-guidelines-agent
description: Asks first for the foundation's own brand or messaging documents and maps them into the standard fields, pulls the project's LFX record and runs a research sweep, interviews only for the gaps (or pre-fills in batch mode), and generates a short project Brand Kit — a two-page Review Sheet for the ED, then positioning, brand principle, voice and prefer/avoid language, what we don't claim, competitive guardrails, LFX-derived governance and trademark wording, and a five-component visual identity direction — held to a 6–8 page budget, delivered Google Docs-ready on the LF Agent DOCS Template with a structured .fields.yaml sidecar for downstream agents.
